title: Uncaught ZeroDivisionError in bulk order discount calculator
root_cause: ZeroDivisionError in calculate_unit_discount when promo_items or total_items is zero
visible_symptoms: POST /orders fails with HTTP 500 on promotional discount calculation
Orders log records ZeroDivisionError: division by zero in calculate_unit_discount()
suggested_patch:
--- a/target-app/services/orders/app.py
+++ b/target-app/services/orders/app.py
@@ -75,2 +75,4 @@
-    return total_discount / total_items
+    if total_items <= 0:
+        return 0.0
+    return round(total_discount / total_items, 2)
